structured_data.title: Ice Age
structured_data.description: Back when the Earth was being overrun by glaciers, and animals were scurrying to save themselves from the upcoming Ice Age, a sloth named Sid, a woolly mammoth named Manny, and a saber-toothed tiger named Diego are forced to become unlikely heroes. The three reluctantly come together when they have to return a human child to its father while braving the deadly elements of the impending Ice Age.
structured_data.writer: Michael Berg, Michael J. Wilson, Peter Ackerman
structured_data.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 5 wins & 30 nominations total
